description: UltraFeedback experiment specification; audited defaults for new runs, historical manifests remain authoritative for old runs
actor_note: p9d: switched from the instruct Qwen3-14B (already aligned, no headroom) to the pretrained base, matching the BLEUBERI setup

initialization.other_actors: require an explicit matching native-EOS init adapter

hardware.protocol_note: formal profile_vllm_full uses 3 GPUs; native HF rollout uses the actor GPU and requires 2 GPUs total

data.split_strategy: NFC and whitespace normalized prompt SHA256 ascending; first 2000 validation

shared.learning_rate_note: matches run_skywork_500.sh; override and record per experiment
shared.sampling_constraint_policy: top_p=1 and top_k=0; sampling temperature and minimum-token stop suppression also apply to training probabilities

vpo_rm.tau_note: Plan B (see tau失配与修复方案.md): softmax runs over the per-response standardized utility, so tau is dimensionless; p9c's raw-utility softmax at tau=1 measured ESS 0.998 (mechanism inert)
vpo_rm.credit_standardization: mean/std over unfrozen response positions with relative floor 1e-3 of mean|d|; frozen tokens have weight 1; dynamically bracket and solve both final bounds [1/lambda,lambda]
vpo_rm.structural_token_policy: derive IDs from the actual tokenizer: nonempty whitespace, or a newline-containing token that strips to one period; exclude special tokens

offline_rm_eval.prompt_selection: first 256 of the SHA256-ordered 2000 validation prompts; frozen across runs, checkpoints and temperatures

generation.role: greedy column, repetition-loop detector for mid-training checkpoints

offline_rm_eval.scoring: Skywork RM, per-prompt scores logged (eval.jsonl) for paired GRPO-vs-VPO differences and bootstrap CIs

benchmarks: Alpaca prompts with internal GPT-4.1 pairwise judge (not official AlpacaEval 2 length-controlled score)
evaluation.judge_configuration: record the internal judge model, evaluator configuration, and dependency revisions in the run manifest; official AlpacaEval LC is not implemented
